messages.subject: TQM Alpha | Digital services, governance and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear TQM Alpha Leadership Team,

Your insurance and digital-services platform platform aligns closely with my experience leading regulated operations, ESG and country stakeholder priorities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring hands-on experience aligning regulators, communities, strategic partners and internal teams around complex investment and sustainability priorities, including energy-transition and carbon-governance work.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country leadership. I have attached a TQM Alpha-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
